registered_by: lead session. Unit 「지도 지우기 탐침」 is listed in the team lead's night scope statement typed in the lead window at 2026-10-18 00:12 (NIGHT-PLAN 「팀장 직접 입력 · 밤 허용 범위 원문 기록」).
question: B (map arm) got worse during 2000 updates on gap and flat while A stayed level. Is the damage carried by the live map signal, or by the actor weights themselves?

probe_arms.B0: B weights, policy mode B, but the 374-column map input is exactly what A receives (map zeros and validity zeros). Reads: what B does when it is not shown the terrain.
probe_arms.Bc: B weights, the map branch contribution to the actor first layer (actor_in_map output) forced to zero for every step. Reads: what the fine-tuned actor body does with no map pathway at all.

references.A_and_B: existing update-2000 evaluation run evalfull-u2000-live-20261018-002543-8bb6a76b episodes (no rerun). Pairs are matched by case_id. A pair missing on either side is excluded and counted, never imputed.

evaluation.cases: the same 60 registered cases as the A/B evaluation (evaluation_seeds_s2_ab.json, same cases_sha256), fwd10 1.0 m/s, act_inference deterministic, one Kit process per case-arm, missing cases recorded and the run continues
evaluation.success: identical to the A/B evaluation score (crossed baseline and survived)

per_probe_arm_and_primary_layer.signal_hurts: Tango 95% paired interval of (probe - B) has lower bound > 0. Removing the map improves B, so the live map signal is part of the damage.
per_probe_arm_and_primary_layer.weights_damaged: interval of (probe - B) includes 0 AND interval of (probe - A) has upper bound < 0. Removing the map does not help and the probe stays below A, so the damage sits in the weights.
per_probe_arm_and_primary_layer.unclear: anything else. Reported as unclear, not as no effect.

decision_rules.recovery_report: interval of (probe - A) is reported for every layer as the size of recovery. It is not a separate verdict.
decision_rules.no_selective_repetition: one run per probe arm. A low or unexpected result is a valid result. Missing pairs are not refilled without the team lead.
decision_rules.power_note: gap has about 19 valid pairs and flat about 10, so only large differences can be separated.
